points.what: APAC placed 540 orders, up 10.2% week on week, contributing 50 of the 62 extra orders and 80.6% of the change.
points.so_what: Most of the week's order growth rests on a single region, so the weekly total moves with APAC.

points.what: Search delivered 846 orders, 69.4% of the week's total, contributing 47 orders and 75.8% of the week-on-week change.
points.so_what: The bulk of the order growth sits with the largest source, so the weekly order line tracks Search closely.

points.what: LATAM fell to 157 orders, down 18.2% week on week, a contribution of -35 orders and -56.5% of the change.
points.so_what: LATAM was the only region to decline and held back what was otherwise a broad-based rise in orders.

points.what: AOV fell to $83.10, down 5.9% week on week, a change rated bad.
points.so_what: Revenue rose far less than orders did, so the week's growth came from more orders rather than larger baskets.

points.what: The cancellation rate improved to 14.1%, down 1.2 pp week on week and 0.8 pp below last year, both rated good.
points.so_what: With each percentage point of cancellations worth $1,013 of revenue, order quality added to the week's revenue base rather than subtracting from it.

points.what: The 14-Day Return Rate for the mature week of 20 Jul 2026 was 11.0%, the top of its recent eight-week range.
points.so_what: Gross revenue excludes cancellations but not returns, so this rate is the part of the quarter's growth that did not stay with customers.

points.what: New customer signups fell to 237, down 6.7% week on week and 6.7% against last year, both rated bad.
points.so_what: Signups moved the opposite way to the 5.4% rise in orders, so the week's order gain did not come with account growth.
